title: Release gate heuristics and sequence verifier for staged upgrades
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a deterministic, reproducible verification layer that validates a candidate runtime/model combination against versioning and LTS policies prior to rollout. This ticket defines heuristics for ordering upgrade sequence checks, establishes a staged verification harness (including a new canaryless validation mode), and ties smoke/perf/eval signals into a single pass/fail decision that can be consumed by the release orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible verification job runs for a given release tag and outputs a single pass/fail verdict and a signal bundle (telemetry, perf deltas, failing prompts)
Heuristics defined for ordering checks: compatibility, invariant checks, smoke, perf percentiles, semantic-regression evals, and fallback policy verification
Canaryless validation mode implemented: shadow + traffic slowdown + metric-based stop criteria
Automation hooks created to publish verdicts to the release orchestrator and trigger rollbacks or staged roll-forward
Runbook and run-level dashboards created and linked for on-call investigation
success_metrics: Detection of critical regressions within the shortest observed rollout window (target: detect before 5% traffic)
End-to-end verification runtime under 90 minutes for standard deploys
Consistency between canary and canaryless verdicts >= 98% in controlled tests
smoke_tests: API contract checks: authentication, schema, error codes for primary endpoints
KV cache warmup verification: prime representative prefixes and assert hit-rate > 60% at 5m
Basic throughput sanity: sustained QPS at 50th percentile latency budget for 10 minutes
End-to-end sample prompts: deterministic output fingerprint comparison for 20 critical prompts
Circuit-breaker exercise: force dependency degrade and verify graceful fallback path
perf_gates: P50/P95/P99 token latency delta thresholds relative to baseline (P50 < +10%, P95 < +20%, P99 < +30%)
Cost-per-token delta: < +12% relative to baseline for same model profile
Tail-regression alert: any increase in error-rate or timeout rate by >0.5% triggers failure
KV cache miss amplification: miss-rate above threshold causes gate fail
Throughput headroom check: sustained 75% of provisioned capacity must be achievable in synthetic load
eval_suites: Semantic-regression suite: 5k curated prompts covering hallucination, factuality, and instruction-following
Rerank/embedding quality probes for representative downstream tasks
Safety-invariant checks: prompt injection tests and response redaction validation
Multi-turn chat stability suite with KV cache stress scenarios
Canonical random seed run to compare generation divergence metrics
rollout_strategy: Stage 0: Shadow-only validation (no live traffic) to collect signal bundle
Stage 1: Canaryless validation: shadow + synthetic slow-fan traffic to emulate low-traffic canary without user exposure
Stage 2: Small-percentage canary (1-2%) with automatic hold window and metric lookback
Stage 3: Gradual ramp to 25% with dynamic gating based on rolling-window metrics
Stage 4: Full rollout with post-rollout continuous evaluation for 72 hours
automation_tasks: Implement verification operator that accepts a release tag and produces verdict JSON
Add metric collectors for percentile deltas and token-level tracing in verification jobs
Integrate verdict publishing API to release orchestrator and Slack/PagerDuty channels
Create templated CI job to run verification as a gating step before release promotion
Extend existing synthetic workload fabric to support canaryless slow-fan traffic patterns
progress_updates: 2025-02-19: scoped verification steps and drafted heuristics doc; initial alignment with SA and SRE teams
2025-02-24: prototype canaryless slow-fan traffic generator implemented and validated against local runtime; observed stable metric collection
2025-02-28: smoke test harness extended to include KV cache priming and deterministic fingerprinting; integration tests added
2025-03-03: integrated percentile delta collector into verification job; P95 computation matches offline benchmark
2025-03-05: automation hook for publishing verdicts to release orchestrator merged to staging (PR linked)
decisions: Adopt canaryless validation as an option for low-risk customer segments to reduce exposure during global rollouts
Use percentile-delta thresholds rather than absolute latency targets to accommodate heterogenous hardware in Dedicated deployments
Treat semantic eval regressions with higher priority than small perf deltas when making pass/fail decisions
Publish full signal bundle for failed verifications to secure internal storage for postmortem analyses
open_blockers: Need SRE approval for synthetic traffic capacity on production clusters
Missing baseline dataset for some enterprise customer prompts — legal clearance required to store fingerprints
Dashboard template for verification signal fusion not yet provisioned in Console
notes: This ticket intentionally separates canaryless from canary modes; both should be supported and cross-validated to build confidence
Keep verification runtime bounded: long-running full-evals should run asynchronously and feed regression alerts but not block immediate release decisions
Work with Product to define customer-facing SLO language that matches internal gating criteria
